title: Women in Hasidic Literature: Between Close and Distant Reading — Dataset
description: Annotated TEI XML editions and topic-tag dataset for nine 19th-century Hasidic hagiographic collections, accompanying the article 'Women in Hasidic Literature: Between Close and Distant Reading.' Topics are manually curated; the 'women in story' column is a binary (presence-strict) projection of a five-tier annotation produced with LLM assistance and human curation. The dataset includes the underlying 5-tier labels for transparency.
notes: Women tags reflect the five-tier scheme; the binary women_in_story column in the TSV is a presence-strict projection of those labels. See CHANGES.md for details.
